query: I have a 51-year-old male inpatient. Among male inpatients 46–56 with acute myocardial infarction, stratify by the composite risk score (age plus major complications) into quintiles and report in-hospital mortality%, major complication%, and median survivor LOS per quintile.
final_sql:
WITH PatientInfo AS (
  SELECT
    subject_id,
    gender,
    anchor_age,
    hadm_id
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients`
  WHERE
    gender = 'M' AND anchor_age BETWEEN 46 AND 56
),
DiagnosisInfo AS (
  SELECT
    p.subject_id,
    p.hadm_id,
    d.icd_code
  FROM
    PatientInfo AS p
    INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` AS d
      ON p.subject_id = d.subject_id AND p.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
  WHERE
    d.icd_code = 'I21.9' -- Acute myocardial infarction
),
ComplicationInfo AS (
  SELECT
    di.subject_id,
    di.hadm_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT di.icd_code) AS num_complications
  FROM
    DiagnosisInfo AS di
    INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` AS d
      ON di.subject_id = d.subject_id AND di.hadm_id = d.hadm_id
